choke.definition:
n. a coil of low resistance and high inductance used in electrical circuits to pass direct current and attenuate alternating current
n. a valve that controls the flow of air into the carburetor of a gasoline engine
v. breathe with great difficulty, as when experiencing a strong emotion
v. be too tight; rub or press
choke.translation:
vt. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎, 抑制
vi. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎
n. 窒息, 噎, 阻气门

choke coil.translation: [医] 抗流线圈, 抗流镍蟠

choke damp.translation: [建] 窒息气, 二氧化碳气

choke off.translation: 中止做; 使放弃做; 批评; 责备

choke sb off.translation: 使某人放弃做某事, 除掉某人

choke up.translation: 塞住, 噎住, 阻塞

chokeberry.definition:
n. The small apple-shaped or pear-shaped fruit of an
   American shrub (Pyrus arbutifolia) growing in damp thickets; also, the
   shrub.

chokecherry.definition:
n. the fruit of the chokecherry tree
n. a common wild cherry of eastern North America having small bitter black berries favored by birds

choked.translation: a. 生气的, 恼怒的；堵塞的

chokedamp.definition: n. the atmosphere in a mine following an explosion; high in carbon dioxide and incapable of supporting life
chokedamp.translation:
n. 窒息性气体
[医] 乌烟, 窒息毒气(矿内煤源所产生的毒气)

chokehold.definition: n. a restraining hold; someone loops the arm around the neck of another person in a tight grip, usually from behind

chokepoint.definition:
n. a narrowing that reduces the flow through a channel
n. a point of congestion or blockage

choker.definition:
n. an unfortunate person who is unable to perform effectively because of nervous tension or agitation
n. necklace that fits tightly around a woman's neck
n. a high tight collar
choker.translation: n. 噎住的人, 窒息物, 宽领带

chokers.definition:
n. someone who kills by strangling
n. an unfortunate person who is unable to perform effectively because of nervous tension or agitation
n. necklace that fits tightly around a woman's neck
chokers.translation: n. 噎住的人, 使人窒息之物, 宽领带( choker的复数形式 )

chokey.definition: n. British slang (dated) for a prison

a. 使人窒息的, 气闷的
